title: Male redback spiders somersault directly towards a female’s fangs during mating

title: 'Unprecedented transformation': Rajnath hails fourfold rise in defence production
content: the defence sector has undergone an "unprecedented transformation" over the past 12 years . domestic defence production rose nearly fourfold to a record Rs 1.78 lakh crore in 2025-26 . he said the government has always accorded the highest priority to self-reliance .

title: When help starts hurting: How $2.6tn in aid trapped Africa in poverty
content: more than $2.6 trillion dollars of aid has been funneled into Africa since 1960s . this is more than half of India’s GDP just in ‘charitable donations’ . aid support to Africa was at its peak between 1970-1988 .

title: 'Terrorists will face consequences': Prez Murmu addresses nation on I-Day eve
content: president Droupadi Murmu addressed the nation on the eve of the 80th Independence day . she praised the nation's growth and said that "every citizen is contributing to nation building" a key quote from the president's address is the duty of every person associated with judicial system to ensure that no one is deprived of justice due to lack of resources .

title: Second train derails in Southeast England within 24 hours; no injuries reported
content: second train derailed in southeast england in less than 24 hours . rear carriages remained upright after derailing . emergency services, including police, paramedics and firefighters, were sent to the scene . cause of the derailment not immediately known .

title: In 1974, Vietnam veteran moved to Alaska; 14 years later he made US history
content: Kenneth Deardorff arrived in 1974 with a geography degree and plans to find work with the us geological survey or another employer . he settled in an isolated area with no nearby roads, hunted and trapped for income and operated a small general store while developing his property . by then, the Homestead Act had ended for new claims in Alaska .
